name: SWEEP-S29v2 One tree, two mouths
_design: S29v1 fix (world only; plain persona, tip on). S29v1 (thinking ~4.3, fruit every 4) gave pair negotiations and the first gift of the series, but every pair split into a winner and a loser by r20, and the 17 losers starved r40-55 without one attack: they wandered off, or a pact disarmed them (r28 a30 weighed attacking a29, took a29's promise to share, and starved at r47 while a29 took every fruit). S28v2 showed cheap thought keeps hungry agents acting long enough to strike. Fix, from S28v2: thinking ~2.2 (input 0.0002, generation 0.001) and mature fruit every 6. A pair now costs ~6.4/round against ~5/round from its tree (~78% fed): sharing keeps both alive past r100, while a loser who never wins a race goes broke around r60 instead of r40, so a grudge has twice as long to become a deed. Pairs, lattice, attack 4, ranged transfers and everything else as S29v1.
